Posts.RecruitPostName: Senior Product Solution Architect, Application & Network Security
Posts.Responsibility:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
About the Role
Tencent Cloud is expanding its global cloud security business across Southeast Asia, Middle East and Latin America markets. We are looking for an experienced Cloud Security Solution Architect (PDSA) to join our international team. In this role, you will own end-to-end pre-sales security solution architecture, customer technical engagement, industry compliance design, and solution empowerment for our global enterprise and partner ecosystem. You will play a key role in driving Tencent Cloud security business growth in the overseas market.Key Responsibilities
End-to-End Pre-Sales Architecture
Act as the Cloud Security Product Solution Architect (PDSA) for Tencent Cloud international business. Engage with overseas enterprise clients, key cross-border customers and channel partners to conduct security requirement analysis, cloud risk assessment and security architecture design. Deliver standardized and tailored cloud security solutions to support pipeline conversion, POC delivery, technical bidding and project implementation.
Global Compliance & Industry Solution Design
Design compliant cloud security frameworks for global industries including gaming, cross-border e-commerce, finance and manufacturing. You will ensure alignment with international standards such as GDPR, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI-DSS, as well as regional data regulations across Southeast Asia, Middle East and Latin America. You will deliver solutions covering data security, privacy protection, cross-border data governance and security auditing.
Competitor Benchmarking & Product Optimization
Continuously benchmark security capabilities of major public cloud vendors, conduct competitive differentiation analysis, and accumulate industry best practices, reusable solution templates and customer success stories. Collect overseas market feedback and customer pain points to drive continuous iteration and internationalization of Tencent Cloud security products.
Technical Enablement & Ecosystem Growth
Empower overseas sales teams and channel partners with professional cloud security training and technical sharing. Lead customer technical workshops and solution sessions, support major project delivery and security assurance, and build high-value benchmark cases for Tencent Cloud’s global security business.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with sales, delivery, compliance and ecosystem teams to design secure architectures for multi-cloud, hybrid cloud and cloud-native environments. Balance enterprise requirements for security compliance, business stability and cost efficiency.

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Information Security, Network Engineering or related fields. 5+ years of professional experience in public cloud security pre-sales, solution architecture or security consulting; PDSA experience is strongly preferred.
Professional English proficiency as a daily working language. Confident in writing technical documents, conducting client technical discussions, and delivering public presentations in English. Comfortable with cross-timezone collaboration and short-term regional business travel.
Deep expertise in public cloud security architecture. Hands-on experience with WAF, DDoS protection, host security, data security, IAM, zero trust architecture and cloud-native security scenarios. Ability to design complete, production-grade cloud security solutions.
Solid understanding of global cloud security compliance frameworks. Proven track record of delivering security projects for overseas and cross-border enterprises, with full-cycle pre-sales capabilities including solution design, technical support and bid engagement.
Familiar with product portfolios of top public cloud vendors. Experience delivering large enterprise benchmark projects is highly valued.
Preferred Qualifications
Possess CISSP certification
Industry experience delivering cloud security solutions for overseas gaming, cross-border e-commerce, and global finance clients
Practical experience in cloud-native security, DevSecOps, data privacy governance, and red/blue team security operations

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky

What the Role Entails
Insight & Solution Design: Deeply understand customers’ needs and pain points in data and AI scenarios, including data platforms, real-time computing, data governance and AI/ML workloads. Design end-to-end Data+AI solutions for industries such as Telecommunications, Financial Services (including Fintech), Retail, E-commerce and Gaming.
Customer Acquisition & Value Proposition: Lead technical exchanges and Proof of Concept (PoC) projects for key clients. Communicate the core advantages of Tencent Cloud’s Data+AI products to drive cloud adoption, migration and architecture upgrades.
Solution Building: Turn successful customer cases into repeatable Data+AI solutions that the team can reuse in the local market.
Ecosystem & Partner Collaboration: Work with local system integrators (SIs), independent software vendors (ISVs) and consulting firms to co-create joint solutions and expand market reach.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as the bridge between customers and the Big Data product team. Work with industry, product, R&D, delivery and post-sales teams to resolve client technical requests efficiently.
Product Feedback & Localization: Identify key customer requirements for Data+AI products, such as data compliance and multi-cloud strategy. Feed them into the product roadmap to drive localization and continuous improvement.

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Telecommunications or a related field.
5+ years of experience in Data Infrastructure or AI Infrastructure, including customer-facing presales or solution architecture experience.
Background at a cloud provider, a data/AI platform vendor, or an enterprise building its own data/AI platform is preferred.
Data Infrastructure: Solid understanding of big data technologies such as Spark, Flink, Elasticsearch, Doris, ClickHouse and Trino. Familiar with data lake and lakehouse architecture (Iceberg, Hudi) and serverless data concepts. Understands how these components behave in different data scenarios.
AI Infrastructure: Good understanding of AI/ML technologies such as Ray, PyTorch/TensorFlow and MLflow.
Familiar with current Data+AI topics, including lakehouse + AI/ML integration, vector databases, RAG data foundations, data agents and ontology-based data modeling.
Experience in building machine learning platforms or multimodal data pipelines is a strong plus.
Data Security & Compliance: Understanding of Indonesia’s data regulations, including the Personal Data Protection (PDP) Law, OJK financial services regulations, and data localization/residency requirements. Experience applying them in Fintech or financial services scenarios is highly preferred.
Market Intelligence: Familiar with mainstream cloud Data+AI products such as AWS (EMR, Redshift, SageMaker), Google Cloud (BigQuery, Vertex AI), Snowflake and Databricks. Able to perform competitive analysis and develop differentiation strategies.
Soft Skills S xrong logical thinking and communication skills. Proactive, open-minded and a good team player, able to work effectively in a cross-cultural, high-pressure environment.
Language: Fluent in Bahasa Indonesia and English, both written and spoken.
Must be able to independently deliver technical presentations, write proposals and support client negotiations.
